name: P.E. Analytics Ltd (PropEquity)
tagline: Debt-free micro-cap (~Rs 228 Cr) running PropEquity, India's dominant subscription real-estate transaction database (18-yr proprietary dataset), plus Propedge valuation services - ~40% pre-tax margins, big TAM headroom, trades ~14.6x (~7x ex-cash), Propedge back to growth and a fresh HDFC Capital strategic investment; tempered by mid-teens (not 37%) growth, a large idle cash pile dragging blended ROE to ~16%, and scope-creep across 7 verticals + Middle East + a mooted MBA school
business_overview: Owns/operates PropEquity - subscription database of ~1.4-1.7 lakh projects across 44+ cities, sold to developers (70%+ of India's top 100), 100+ banks/NBFCs and ~35 PE funds - plus Propedge, a property-valuation subsidiary (expanded 10 -> 38 cities). Now describes itself as 7 verticals (subscription data, valuations, research & consulting, plus newer lines). Asset-light, subscription-led, ~40% pre-tax margin, debt-free with ~Rs 113 Cr cash/investments. Has stopped earlier speculative F&O activity. Incorporated PropEquity Middle East (Dubai, Aug-2024); PropEquity AI is being built in a separately-funded subsidiary (PropEquity Tech Pvt Ltd).
fundamentals_table: FY26 ~Rs 53.8 Cr (+21% YoY) / ~Rs 15.7 Cr (+22%); EPS Rs 14.97 (screener TTM shows ~Rs 47 Cr / Rs 16 Cr on a different basis)
Operating ROCE very high (small operating capital); consolidated/blended ROCE ~21%, ROE ~16% (dragged by ~Rs 113 Cr cash = ~half of book value Rs 100/sh)
~37% FY24 -> ~21% FY26; 3-yr sales CAGR ~17%, profit CAGR ~15%; management targets Rs 500-1,000 Cr long term
fundamentals_narrative: High-quality economics for its size - ~40% pre-tax margins, debt-free, high operating ROCE - anchored by a genuine data moat: 18 years of month-on-month primary-transaction coverage, ~Rs 300 Cr invested in datasets, and >70% of India's top-100 developers plus 100+ lenders and ~35 PE funds as clients (real switching cost once a bank standardises on it for underwriting). This deep-dive tempered three things in the prior write-up: (1) blended returns are lower than stated - consolidated ROE is ~16%, not ~26%, because roughly half of book value sits in idle cash earning little and there is no dividend; the ~34% figure was an operating/standalone read; (2) growth has decelerated from ~37% (FY24) to ~21% (FY26), and client count has been closer to flat QoQ - recent growth is more price/existing-client than new logos; (3) the company is spreading itself across 7 verticals, a Dubai entity, a proposed real-estate MBA school and a separately-funded AI subsidiary - broad for a ~Rs 54 Cr-revenue business. Offsetting positives confirmed this pass: the Propedge valuation division has stabilised and returned to growth (company + trusted-user), and HDFC Capital Advisors is coming onto the cap table via an ~Rs 8 Cr preferential issue (with special rights) plus a term sheet validating the PropEquity AI round. Stock trades ~14.6x trailing, roughly 7x ex-cash.
technical_read: Not independently pulled. Price ~Rs 210 vs a prior ~Rs 231 Cr cap reference; recovered from the 2024 lows after the valuation-division wobble.

No SEBI action; no red-flag tier.

~40% pre-tax margin, debt-free, high operating ROCE; trades ~14.6x trailing (~7x ex the Rs 113 Cr cash) - little growth is priced in

verdict_headline: High-quality debt-free data micro-cap with a real moat, big TAM headroom and a cheap ex-cash multiple - 10x-in-2-3-years retained at Medium-High conviction; the deep-dive confirms the Propedge recovery and adds an HDFC Capital validation, but also a reality check on ~16% blended ROE, mid-teens growth and multi-vertical scope creep
verdict_reasoning: four-box score 3.5 (moat yes, tam yes, valuation yes ex-cash; tailwind weak on cyclicality + growth decel) - the return-magnitude label is permitted for a Rs 228 Cr cap with this quality and a Rs 300-500 Cr valuation-services TAM alone

Conviction held at Medium-High: the valuation-division recovery is now independently confirmed (company + harsh.beria93) and HDFC Capital's stake + AI term sheet are genuine positives that offset the new negatives - a lower-than-stated blended ROE (~16% on the cash drag), decelerating growth (37% -> 21%), and scope creep across 7 verticals + Middle East + a mooted MBA school
Held short of High by thin disclosure, flat client adds, and the PropEquity-AI-in-a-separate-subsidiary structure (value-accrual to listed shareholders unclear)
revisit_after_30d set - watch client-count growth resuming, Propedge sustaining the recovery, cash deployment/dividend policy, and the PropEquity AI fundraise terms
